citation: Thomas et al. (2013), Icarus 226, 999–1019; NAIF PCK00011 BODY633_RADII.
orientation: XYZ long, intermediate and polar axes; IAU_PALLENE, east-positive mesh longitude. Photographic frame uses archived mission geometry and fitted image center. Runtime orientation is a stated historical-pole display approximation.
qualification: An analytic realization of measured ellipsoid dimensions. It is not a measured detailed mesh, and no crater or terrain radius is invented.
